OECD raises India's FY27 growth forecast to 7.1%

The OECD increased its projection for India's fiscal year 2027 gross domestic product growth to 7.1%, noting that structural policy reforms that improve economies' ability to handle supply‑side disruptions are a key priority for governments at the current juncture.
